people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Bethlehem
people.line: City of David's birth and Jesus' birth.

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
translations.bsb: Later, they set out from Bethel, and while they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth, and her labor was difficult.
translations.kjv: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was still some distance to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labor.
